rows.quote: The Agency, medicines regulatory authorities in EEA Member States and in third countries, MAHs, academia as well as WHO-UMC are responsible for: • Ensuring confidentiality of ICSR data in accordance with the applicable law on personal data protection; • Protecting personal data in accordance with the applicable law on personal data protection; • Implementing appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect information and personal data processed against unauthorised or unlawful access, disclosure, dissemination, alteration, or destruction or accidental loss in accordance with the applicable law on personal data protection.

f.title: Treat Level 2B data as confidential, use only for signal management or PV assessment, never identify data subjects
f.statement: The signatory agrees to treat all Level 2B information as confidential and use it for signal management (GVP Module IX) or a pharmacovigilance assessment procedure such as the PSUR (GVP Module VII) or when required by PRAC, in compliance with data protection legislation, and not to seek to identify, profile, contact or target data subjects.

f.applicability: Superseded version (replaced by EudraVigilance Access Policy Revision 5, EMA/759287/2009, 16 Apr 2025). EMA policy on access to EudraVigilance data, Revision 4 (23 Aug 2019); MAH (Stakeholder Group III) duties and access rights only.

f.title: Do not transfer Level 2B data to third parties without a legal obligation
f.statement: The signatory agrees not to transfer or dispose of Level 2B data to any third party where there is no legal obligation for the MAH to do so, and shall not permit any third party to access, study, analyse, refer to or otherwise use the data or permit any party to reproduce any ICSR data.

f.title: Pseudonymise personal data when reporting to third-country authorities
f.statement: The signatory shall ensure personal information is pseudonymised when the MAH is legally required to report suspected adverse reactions for its EEA-authorised products to a third-country regulatory authority, so that reported personal data can no longer be attributed to a specific data subject.

f.title: Maintain technical and security measures for Level 2B data
f.statement: The signatory agrees to maintain adequate technical and security measures to prevent unauthorised or unlawful access, disclosure, dissemination, alteration, destruction, accidental loss or copying of Level 2B data, in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.
